scope: Visible 1917 Recorder House, curved platform, 1883–1888 tunnel inlet with plaque and grating, and attached catwalks.
geometryBasis: Mapped 1917 recorder/inlet site way 448005769. The exact curved platform and rectangular landward end register the estimated above-ground enclosure.
sectionBasis: Coursed granite recorder house, flat roof with plain coping, simple entrance; a pediment and iron grating identify the earlier intake on the same mapped platform.
limitations: The model preserves the mapped curved outline and landward rectangle. House dimensions, house position within that envelope, fittings and limestone/granite tones are estimates from the site description.
The visible intake portal and grate are represented at the edge of the platform. The underground tunnel and historical hydraulic operating height are outside the scope of the exterior model.
The 5 m government terrain field was preserved. The height transition to the original ground, footings, catwalk spans and local platform levels are approximate.

facts.purpose: recorder house built across the tunnel inlet to monitor flows
